text: Forgot my sister's birthday completely. Haven't replied to the group chat in two weeks, cancelled on Jess again. I get home, eat crisps over the sink and go to bed at 9. The weekend just disappears.
Somebody asked what I do for fun and I genuinely couldn't answer. Work, sleep, work. The project launched and everyone was celebrating and I felt nothing.

Long day. Met Ana for lunch which was lovely, then did a big food shop, sorted the spice rack alphabetically, watched a documentary about octopuses. The grant application is still sitting there. It's fine, I've got till Thursday. Or Wednesday? Should check.
Bought a new planner, colour coded the whole month, made a beautiful study timetable. Haven't actually studied yet.
Group project feedback came back and they put my section first as an example. I keep reading it waiting to find the sarcasm. Tom must have rewritten most of it.
My friend asked me to be best man and my first thought was that he must have asked other people first.
Boss put a 'quick chat' in my calendar for tomorrow with no description. Haven't been able to eat dinner. Went through every email I've sent this month looking for what I did wrong.
Checked the door was locked three times, then drove back to check again. Felt stupid but couldn't shake the feeling.
The wedding speech is in two weeks. I've written eleven versions. Every one has a line that's slightly off so I start again from scratch.
Turned down the chance to show my paintings at the cafe. They're not ready. They might never be ready.
Rubbish week overall but the bus driver waited for me when he saw me running, and the barista remembered my order. Little things.
Mum's scan came back clear. Sat in the car park and just cried with relief. Called everyone.
Not much to report. Up at 6, cold shower, hour of reading, work, gym, bed by 10. Same as yesterday. Same as tomorrow. That's the point.
Wanted the wine so badly tonight but it's day 40 and I'm not breaking it now.
Corrected the consultant in front of the whole team when his numbers were wrong. Old me would have kept quiet and fumed about it later.
Wore the red dress to the party. Didn't spend the night worrying how I looked for once.
Kid knocked juice over my laptop. I could feel myself about to lose it, counted to ten in my head, and we cleaned it up together. Proud of that one.
Went from laughing to slamming doors within an hour today over the washing up. I don't understand where it comes from.
Uni open day for the masters. Walked round the labs and felt something switch on that's been off for ages. Started the application on the train home.
The guitar's been in the corner gathering dust since summer. I keep looking at it. I just don't feel like it anymore.
